title: Why a Railroad Blamed Robbers for Its Own Broken Bridge #history #shorts
description:
In 1896 a passenger train fell 110 feet off a bridge into Alabama's Cahaba River. The railroad offered $10,000 for the robbers who wrecked it. The neighbors said there were no robbers.

The full story: https://youtu.be/drlD0nZ6D3A

The case that the bridge itself failed is a historian's argument from the railroad's records (Terri Hicks, 2012; Scott Huffard). No court ever ruled on it. The scenes are an animated dramatization.

#history #shorts #alabama
comment: Robbers or a bad bridge: which do you believe?
